input: Register the kids for summer camp early

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many children and whether they are going to the same or different camps determines the complexity and number of registration steps involved.
Understanding who the camps are for (ages, needs, interests) shapes which specific camps are even suitable options.
Whether a specific camp has already been chosen or research is still needed fundamentally changes what the first action is.
A budget ceiling rules out certain camps and determines whether financial aid applications are also part of the task.
Knowing the registration deadline or the early-registration cutoff sets the urgency and sequencing of every step.
Camp type (day vs. overnight, specialty theme, location) narrows the field dramatically and determines what to prioritize when comparing options.
Clarifying what 'done' looks like — confirmation email, deposit paid, forms submitted — defines the actual finish line for this task.

gold.taskTitle: Register the kids for summer camp early
gold.taskDescription: Complete the registration process for one or more children to attend summer camp ahead of a deadline or capacity cutoff.

questions.title: How many kids are you registering for camp?
questions.description: Establish the number of children involved and whether they will attend the same camp or different ones.

questions.title: What are the ages and interests of each child?
questions.description: Capture each child's age and any specific interests or needs that would make a camp a good fit for them.

questions.title: Have you already chosen a specific camp, or is research still needed?
questions.description: Determine whether this task starts at the research phase or moves straight to filling out registration forms.

questions.title: What is your total budget for camp this summer?
questions.description: Identify any spending limit that would filter out certain camps or trigger the need to explore financial aid or scholarships.

questions.title: When is the registration deadline or early-bird cutoff?
questions.description: Pin down the exact date by which registration must be completed to capture the early spot or discount.

questions.title: Do you prefer a day camp, overnight camp, or a specialty theme?
questions.description: Capture style and format preferences — such as sports, arts, STEM, or nature — to narrow the search to the right camp type.

questions.title: What does a fully completed registration look like to you?
questions.description: Define the finish line — for example, receiving a confirmation email, paying the deposit, or submitting all required medical and consent forms.
